concerns.text: FR-008 and SC-006 require validation against an INDEPENDENT PUBLISHED therapy-response signature ("the gene set from PMID 32012345") via Fisher's exact test. The plan's Phase 7 instead derives the signature from GSE138852 responder/non-responder labels: "therapy-response signature derived from GSE138852 responder vs. non-responder labels if actually present". No plan element acquires or uses the published PMID 32012345 gene set, so FR-008/SC-006 as written are unbacked. Either add a step to obtain the published signature (with verified-source handling) or kick back to the spec to amend FR-008.
